propositions: Detached compaction sweep that dies between rename and commit leaves the tracker working tree dirty (tracked deletions and untracked snapshot/retired files), aborting the next reconverge and stranding ticket commits.

Compaction fold must be crash-atomic: write intent journal before mutation, perform ordered snapshot-write→rename→commit with rollback on any failure, and recover abandoned folds at sweep startup by discriminating landed vs partial vs superseded states.
On incomplete rollback (reverse-rename fails), the uncommitted snapshot must be retained as SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT for fsck repair rather than deleted, preventing loss of folded events.
Recovery probe for snapshot presence must distinguish transient git faults (rc-124, index.lock) from permanent absence, deferring journal clearance on transience to avoid reverting landed folds.
Each fold commits independently inside its own locked section so a killed sweep strands zero dirty mutations instead of an entire uncommitted batch.
Interim mitigation compact.trigger=off must be removable once crash-atomic fold lands and is verified to converge at every step boundary.
